_doc: AI key -> answer on the pessimistic Plus profile over LTE, scripted hub with ~1.4 s time to first token. Targets are design goals (foundation 4.5, 6.4).

ai.answers.why: the two asks without an outage must complete

ai.failures.why: the ask during the outage must fail visibly, not hang

ai.press_to_listening_visible_ms.p95.why: the device must show it is listening within ~0.5 s

ai.release_to_first_text_visible_ms.p95.why: first answer text on screen (includes ~1.4 s hub/model time)

ai.release_to_error_visible_ms.max.why: a lost answer must be reported within seconds (dead connection detection)

mem.internal_total.min_free_bytes.why: SR-PL-04 floor: internal RAM (incl. the DMA reserve) an internal-only allocation can still get

mem.dma.min_free_bytes.why: keep at least half of the DMA reserve for runtime DMA users (I2S, SDMMC, Wi-Fi buffers)
